result.paraphrase: Experience powerful, accelerated gaming tailored for you with the RX 5500 XT. The new RDNA-powered Gigabyte Radeon RX 5500 XT OC delivers outstanding performance and high-fidelity gaming. Take command with Radeon RX 5500 XT and enjoy powerful, accelerated play customized for your needs. The 5500 XT powers the world’s most technologically advanced 1080p gaming systems. Gigabyte’s WINDFORCE cooling system with alternate-spinning fans helps this card stay cool and perform among the best. The Gigabyte RX 5500 XT OC lets you use PCI-Express 4.0 support, with 16 GT/s throughput and twice the bandwidth of PCI Express 3.0 for even more immersive gaming experiences. The back plate not only adds visual appeal but also strengthens the graphics card structure for full protection. 1408 stream processors, 8GB GDDR6 memory, 1647 MHz core clock, 1845 MHz boost clock, Gigabyte Windforce cooling technology, 2 x 90mm alternating blade fans. The WINDFORCE 2X cooling system uses two 90mm unique blade fans that spin alternately, along with 3 composite copper heat pipes, heat-pipe direct touch, and 3D active fan functionality, delivering effective heat dissipation for higher performance at lower temperatures. Gigabyte spins the adjacent fans in opposite directions so the airflow between them moves the same way, reducing turbulence and increasing airflow pressure. Combining different cooling solutions, the unique blade fan effectively enhances airflow. The 3D Active Fan provides semi-passive cooling, keeping the fans off during low load or low power gameplay so gamers can enjoy complete silence when the system is light or idle. Airflow is split by the triangular fan edge and guided smoothly through the 3D stripe curve on the fan surface, effectively improving airflow. The pure copper heat pipes are shaped to maximize direct contact with the GPU and improve heat transfer. Brand-new RDNA architecture with 7nm process reduces latency and provides higher bandwidth. Powered by the groundbreaking 7nm RDNA architecture with Radeon Image Sharpening and Radeon Anti-Lag, the Radeon RX 5500 XT GPU delivers highly efficient, ultra-responsive, high-fidelity gaming with immersive explosions, physics, and lighting effects that bring realism to life. Take gaming to the next level. Enjoy stutter-free, tear-free play, reduced input latency, and day-0 drivers optimized for new game releases. Featuring GDDR6 memory and PCIe 4.0 compatibility, it offers super-fast performance for today’s demanding titles. Equipped with 8GB of advanced GDDR6 memory providing up to 224 GB/s bandwidth, it enables 1080p performance for today’s most demanding games. Radeon RX 5500 XT includes PCI® Express 4.0 support, giving twice the bandwidth of PCI Express 3.0. Get ready for the next generation of PC gaming. Superior gaming performance with FreeSync monitors delivers a smooth refresh rate so you can game at your best. Pair your new AMD Radeon GPU with a wide selection of FreeSync gaming monitors. With many monitors featuring Radeon FreeSync or Radeon FreeSync2 HDR, you can choose the style and operation you want, and by combining a FreeSync monitor with an AMD card of this caliber, you get a stutter-free, tear-free, artifact-free smooth gaming experience.
